purpose: Domain-neutrality boundary rules for platform-level research reports. Injected as DATA so that tools/tests/backend stay free of domain vocabulary (AGENT_BOOTSTRAP ECOSYSTEM-MAP iron rule: zero domain semantics in code; domain data arrives via config/API/artifacts).

precedent.rule: A platform report keeps organization-level metrics only (throughput, concurrency, coverage matrix, BP-goal coverage). Domain-engineering detail is referenced, never reproduced.
precedent.domain_doc_hint: campaign documentation of the domain repository (campaign plans 11-13)

detail_patterns.why: principal-dimension triplet of a specific vessel (domain engineering detail)
installed power of a specific power plant (domain engineering detail)
named geographic route between waypoints (domain engineering detail); spacing-free arrow form only, so architecture diagrams ('A → B' with spaces) are not flagged
environmental state matrix enumerated for one domain case

whitelist.reason: Observed campaign registry record (campaign_plans.name). Quoting a recorded title is data citation, not platform-embedded domain semantics; detail patterns are still enforced on these lines.
Reference/navigation lines that point to the domain repository instead of restating the case.
